name: Bloodplains
description: The savage orc territories, featuring volcanic mountains, war camps, and scorched battlefields

musicalTheme.instruments: War drums, bone flutes, low brass, chanting

tracks.name: March of the Warlords
tracks.sunoPrompt: Primal orc war march in G minor with thunderous pounding war drums and aggressive low brass horns and tribal bone percussion with savage volcanic wasteland atmosphere and relentless driving rhythm at aggressive tempo with warrior spirit fury and primal battle energy and no mercy

tracks.name: The Warhorn's Rest
tracks.sunoPrompt: Rough orc war camp gathering in G minor with heavy stomping drums and guttural chanting voices and primitive bone instruments with fire pit celebration atmosphere and boisterous tribal rhythm at rowdy tempo with warrior boasting and victory songs and crude brotherhood

tracks.name: The War Spoils Bazaar
tracks.sunoPrompt: Tribal orc trading post music in G minor with steady war drum pulse and harsh bone flute accents and deep brass growls with war spoils marketplace atmosphere and aggressive bartering rhythm at moderate tense tempo with crude weapons and brutal commerce

tracks.name: The Bloodriver Shallows
tracks.sunoPrompt: Primal orc hunting music in G minor with sparse tribal drum heartbeat and low droning bone flute and distant war horn echoes with muddy volcanic river atmosphere and patient predator rhythm at slow deliberate tempo with savage patience and hunter instinct

tracks.name: Bones of the Old Wars
tracks.sunoPrompt: Ancient orc battlefield ruins music in G minor with mournful low brass dirge and scattered bone percussion echoes and ghostly war chant whispers with scorched earth monument atmosphere and haunted puzzle-solving tension at slow tempo with ancestral warrior spirits and fallen glory
